description: Bitcoin only, beta. One timeframe's analysis, its OHLCV candles and the support, resistance and FBB band levels the analysis lists. `granularity` names the bars: 2H, 6H, 8H and 12H are built from TSP's 1h bars, and 1m, 3m, 5m and 15m have levels only, no bars (the finest bars the Signals run takes from TSP are 30m); `note` says so. A built series is judged on the 1h bars it is built from: its health and its freshness are the 1h series' (source_newest_bar_at and source_interval_ms say which bar and cadence). `bars` defaults to the newest 50 and accepts up to 200. The newest bar can carry a partial flag: when true it was read before it closed, ingested_at says when (null if not known), and its high, low and close are as of then. When TSP also marks it live, it has no ingested_at: its high, low and close are a live sample TSP took at as_of (null if not known; extremes is TSP's word for how its high and low were taken, sampled or null), and volume_ingested_at says when its volume was recorded (null if not known). On a built series, live, as_of and volume_ingested_at are its last 1h bar's: only its close is that sample, its high and low span the 1h bars it holds (extremes null), and its volume is their sum. A bar TSP makes from its sample before that interval's bar is recorded is left out, so a series ends at its newest recorded bar: partial is true there when TSP moved its flag from it onto the bar it made, or left it unlabelled with its volume recorded before it closed. Levels, not a trade plan. Not investment advice.
